data.name: refunds_requested_unpaid
refunds_fixed_terms
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_fixed_terms BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds
  WHEN NEW.stay_id IS NOT OLD.stay_id
    OR NEW.nights IS NOT OLD.nights
    OR NEW.price_per_night IS NOT OLD.price_per_night
    OR NEW.amount IS NOT OLD.amount
    OR NEW.requested_by IS NOT OLD.requested_by
    OR NEW.requested_at IS NOT OLD.requested_at
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'refund terms cannot change'); END;

data.name: refunds_paid_once
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_paid_once BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds
  WHEN OLD.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND (
    NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at
    OR NEW.method IS NOT OLD.method
    OR NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT OLD.mpesa_code
    OR NEW.shift_id IS NOT OLD.shift_id
    OR NEW.paid_by IS NOT OLD.paid_by
    OR NEW.receipt_number IS NOT OLD.receipt_number
  )
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'refund is already paid'); END;

data.name: refunds_paid_if_approved
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_paid_if_approved BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds
  WHEN OLD.paid_at IS NULL AND NEW.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM refund_decisions
      WHERE refund_id = NEW.id AND decision = 'approved'
    )
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'refund is not approved'); END;

CREATE TRIGGER payments_mpesa_code_unused_insert BEFORE INSERT ON payments
  WHEN NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds WHERE mpesa_code = NEW.mpesa_code)
  BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'M-Pesa code already used'); END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "username" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (username = lower(trim(username))), "password_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("role" IN ('owner', 'supervisor', 'receptionist')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "must_change_password" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("must_change_password" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER users_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON users WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TRIGGER settings_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON settings WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bed_categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE CHECK (name = trim(name) AND length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 30), "price_per_night" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_night" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER bed_categories_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON bed_categories WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "rooms" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (room_number = upper(trim(room_number))), "floor" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER rooms_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON rooms WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "beds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "room_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rooms (id), "label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("label" IN ('A', 'B')), "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bed_categories (id), "cleanliness" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("cleanliness" IN ('clean', 'not_cleaned')), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("room_id", "label"));
CREATE TRIGGER beds_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON beds WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "housekeepers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER housekeepers_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON housekeepers WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "guests" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "full_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE, "id_type" TEXT NULL CHECK("id_type" IN ('national_id', 'passport', 'alien_id')), "id_number" TEXT COLLATE NOCASE, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (id_number IS NULL OR id_type IS NOT NULL));
CREATE TRIGGER guests_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON guests WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shifts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_float" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("opening_float" >= 0), "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "expected_cash" INTEGER NULL, "expected_paybill" INTEGER NULL, "counted_cash" INTEGER NULL, "variance" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('open', 'closed')), "first_count" INTEGER NULL, "close_note" TEXT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("close_note") <= 200), "closed_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((status = 'open') = (closed_at IS NULL)), CHECK (status = 'open' OR (expected_cash IS NOT NULL AND expected_paybill IS NOT NULL AND counted_cash IS NOT NULL AND variance IS NOT NULL AND variance = counted_cash - expected_cash)), CHECK ((status = 'open') = (closed_by IS NULL)), CHECK ((status = 'open') = (first_count IS NULL)));
CREATE TRIGGER shifts_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON shifts WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END
CREATE TRIGGER shifts_closed_final BEFORE UPDATE ON shifts WHEN OLD.status = 'closed' BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a closed shift cannot be changed');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stays" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "guest_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES guests (id), "bed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beds (id), "check_in_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_until" TEXT NOT NULL, "checked_out_at" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("status" IN ('active', 'closed')), "checked_in_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "checked_out_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "room_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "bed_label" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("bed_label" IN ('A', 'B')), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((status = 'active') = (checked_out_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((status = 'active') = (checked_out_by IS NULL)));
CREATE TRIGGER stays_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON stays WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "shift_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "received_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "received_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("method" IN ('cash', 'paybill')), "mpesa_code" TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "print_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((method = 'paybill') = (mpesa_code IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE TRIGGER payments_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON payments WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stay_charges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stay_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES stays (id), "payment_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES payments (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('check_in', 'extension', 'late_checkout')), "nights" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("nights" >= 1), "price_per_night" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_night" > 0), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "period_start" TEXT NOT NULL, "period_end" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES bed_categories (id), "category_name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount = nights * price_per_night), CHECK (period_end > period_start));
CREATE TRIGGER stay_charges_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON stay_charges WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refunds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "stay_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES stays (id), "nights" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("nights" >= 1), "price_per_night" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("price_per_night" > 0), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "requested_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "requested_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL CHECK("method" IN ('cash', 'paybill')), "mpesa_code" TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE, "shift_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES shifts (id), "paid_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "paid_at" TEXT NULL, "receipt_number" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "print_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (amount = nights * price_per_night), CHECK ((paid_at IS NULL) = (method IS NULL)), CHECK ((paid_at IS NULL) = (shift_id IS NULL)), CHECK ((paid_at IS NULL) = (paid_by IS NULL)), CHECK ((paid_at IS NULL) = (receipt_number IS NULL)), CHECK ((method IS 'paybill') = (mpesa_code IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "housekeeping_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES beds (id), "housekeeper_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES housekeepers (id), "assigned_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "assigned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "completed_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "cancelled_at" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_by" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK ((completed_at IS NULL) = (completed_by IS NULL)), CHECK ((cancelled_at IS NULL) = (cancelled_by IS NULL)), CHECK (completed_at IS NULL OR cancelled_at IS NULL));
CREATE TRIGGER housekeeping_tasks_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON housekeeping_tasks WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "low_stock_level" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("low_stock_level" >= 0), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_items (id), "direction" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("direction" IN ('in', 'out')), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("quantity" > 0), "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "recorded_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER inventory_movements_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON inventory_movements WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "voids" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("target_type" IN ('payment', 'stay', 'refund')), "target_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH(TRIM("reason")) > 0), "voided_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "voided_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("target_type", "target_id"));
CREATE TRIGGER voids_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON voids WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("category" IN ('laundry', 'utilities', 'wages', 'supplies', 'repairs', 'other')), "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount" > 0), "spent_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recorded_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (spent_on GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-1][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]'));
CREATE TRIGGER expenses_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON expenses WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END
CREATE TRIGGER inventory_items_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON inventory_items WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refund_decisions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "refund_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES refunds (id), "decision" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("decision" IN ('approved', 'rejected')), "note" TEXT NULL, "decided_by" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "decided_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (decision = 'approved' OR coalesce(length(trim(note)), 0) > 0));
CREATE TRIGGER refund_decisions_stamped_update BEFORE UPDATE ON refund_decisions WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'must be stamped by writeWithAudit');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "audit_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES users (id), "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "before_json" TEXT NULL, "after_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER stays_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON stays BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'stays rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER payments_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON payments BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'payments rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER stay_charges_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON stay_charges BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'stay_charges rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER voids_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON voids BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'voids rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER audit_log_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON audit_log BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'audit_log is append-only');END
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON refunds BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refunds rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER refund_decisions_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON refund_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refund_decisions rows are never deleted');END
CREATE TRIGGER refund_decisions_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON refund_decisions BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refund_decisions rows are never edited');END
CREATE TRIGGER refunds_requested_unpaid BEFORE INSERT ON refunds WHEN NEW.paid_at IS NOT NULL BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'a refund is requested before it is paid');END

CREATE TRIGGER refunds_fixed_terms BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds WHEN NEW.stay_id IS NOT OLD.stay_id OR NEW.nights IS NOT OLD.nights OR NEW.price_per_night IS NOT OLD.price_per_night OR NEW.amount IS NOT OLD.amount OR NEW.requested_by IS NOT OLD.requested_by OR NEW.requested_at IS NOT OLD.requested_at BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refund terms cannot change');END

CREATE TRIGGER refunds_paid_once BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds WHEN OLD.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND(NEW.paid_at IS NOT OLD.paid_at OR NEW.method IS NOT OLD.method OR NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT OLD.mpesa_code OR NEW.shift_id IS NOT OLD.shift_id OR NEW.paid_by IS NOT OLD.paid_by OR NEW.receipt_number IS NOT OLD.receipt_number)BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refund is already paid');END

CREATE TRIGGER refunds_paid_if_approved BEFORE UPDATE ON refunds WHEN OLD.paid_at IS NULL AND NEW.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refund_decisions WHERE refund_id = NEW.id AND decision = 'approved') BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'refund is not approved');END

CREATE TRIGGER payments_mpesa_code_unused_insert BEFORE INSERT ON payments WHEN NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds WHERE mpesa_code = NEW.mpesa_code) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'M-Pesa code already used');END

CREATE TRIGGER payments_mpesa_code_unused_update BEFORE UPDATE OF mpesa_code ON payments WHEN NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds WHERE mpesa_code = NEW.mpesa_code) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'M-Pesa code already used');END

CREATE TRIGGER refunds_mpesa_code_unused_insert BEFORE INSERT ON refunds WHEN NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE mpesa_code = NEW.mpesa_code) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'M-Pesa code already used');END

CREATE TRIGGER refunds_mpesa_code_unused_update BEFORE UPDATE OF mpesa_code ON refunds WHEN NEW.mpesa_code IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments WHERE mpesa_code = NEW.mpesa_code) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'M-Pesa code already used');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "sent_at" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "receipt_counter" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES device (device_id), "next_number" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("next_number" >= 1), PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE INDEX audit_log_at ON audit_log (at)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_user ON audit_log (user_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_action ON audit_log ("action")
CREATE INDEX audit_log_entity ON audit_log (entity, entity_id)
CREATE INDEX audit_log_operation ON audit_log (operation_id)
CREATE INDEX outbox_unsent ON outbox (seq) WHERE sent_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX guests_phone ON guests (phone)
CREATE INDEX guests_id_number ON guests (id_number)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX guests_id_unique ON guests (id_type, id_number) WHERE id_number IS NOT NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX shifts_one_open_per_device ON shifts (device_id) WHERE status = 'open'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stays_one_active_per_bed ON stays (bed_id) WHERE status = 'active'
CREATE INDEX payments_shift ON payments (shift_id)

CREATE INDEX stay_charges_payment ON stay_charges (payment_id)
CREATE INDEX refunds_shift ON refunds (shift_id)
CREATE INDEX housekeeping_tasks_bed ON housekeeping_tasks (bed_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX housekeeping_tasks_one_open_per_bed ON housekeeping_tasks (bed_id) WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND cancelled_at IS NULL
